When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2741-5256.description:

When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.

When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

2511-3185-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2511-3185-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3497-3967-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
3497-3967-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2034-4460-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

4934-5078-6595.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

539-3088-3899-4552-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3284-3490-4871-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2919-4186-4321-6890.description:
Gain life.

When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

67-261-1676-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-261-1676-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Suture Priest and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Suture Priest triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-261-1676-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

2173-2448-5220-6794.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-6794.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1430-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirror Image.
1430-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
1430-4608-5466.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirror Image's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mirror Image's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Mirror Image's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.

When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.

974-2157-5090.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Romana II.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing the Aura token, giving Phantatog +1/+1 until end of turn.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher, adding {U}.

Resolve the first Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve the second Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, doing nothing.

Resolve the second Goldberry trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Goldberry's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Goldberry onto Teysa, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

Activate Blasted Landscape's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
